blockingFindings.mechanism: Only UPDATE and DELETE triggers exist. SQLite INSERT OR REPLACE can replace an existing primary-key row without firing DELETE triggers when recursive_triggers is off; runtime admission does not require recursive_triggers. Add explicit BEFORE INSERT WHEN EXISTS same identity RAISE(ABORT) for both tables, matching frozen v32 no-replace pattern. Do not rely on the caller avoiding OR REPLACE or an unenforced PRAGMA. This is code inspection, not an executed probe in this review.

Array length2 permits duplicate proofs, arbitrary text, arbitrary object keys and unbounded-within16KiB health text. Permanent non-redacted metadata storage needs a closed proof serialization. Prefer exactly two canonical opaque hash references with strict type/64-lowerhex checks and no duplicates, with publisher proving one current completion for each required job; alternatively enforce an exact closed metadata object shape and reject unknown keys/free text. Array length alone cannot prove two different approved jobs.

schemaHardeningConditions: Integer generation/revision/time fields should enforce typeof integer and safe bounds, consistent with v32; current CHECK >0 allows fractional REAL values under SQLite affinity. Hash/HMAC fields should enforce canonical64-lowercasehex, not length alone.

Deferred receipt FK permits completion insertion before the named work receipt is appended in the same transaction. It proves receipt existence only. Publisher must additionally match receipt.execution_id, receipt.generation, scope/request digests, exact named completion step and original tenant/input scope; the two independent single-column FKs do not enforce these relationships.

Publisher must authenticate both completion_hmac values, demand exactly RECOMPUTE_DERIVED and REPAIR_CURRENTNESS with compatible same-tenant/current scope, and reject stale/duplicate/same-job/peer proof pairs. No completion is minted from counters, flags, metadata rows or a copied SHADOW result.

Completion.original_deadline_at must be derived from original producing execution created_at+45000, not renewed deadline_at. Verify original receipt/finalization ordering and reject finalized_at beyond original deadline; finalized partial recovery is not full publication authority.

Publication signs the complete canonical metadata record, both exact completion proofs, artifact/source/generation manifest and producer seals. Fresh provider/currentness/auth/resource/lifecycle/purge fences must bracket generation and read. These are runtime conditions not proved by DDL alone.

Expiration maximum15min and one immutable publication per input generation are coherent only if expiry never triggers re-signing old work. New input-generation recomputation must perform actual current computation, preserve unchanged source_generation truthfully, and produce new original ACKs.

Unreleased v35 DDL extension must use fresh synthetic fixtures or an explicit successor for any retained durable v35 fixture. Existing version35 databases must fail closed on changed postconditions; do not silently repair previously applied schemas or markers.

After schema correction, test missing/deferred receipt FK, wrong execution/generation, duplicate/no-replace/update/delete attempts, invalid numeric/hash/proof shape, expiry bounds, partial migration interruption/resume and exact profile admission before full functional review.
